edges.notes: createForum (server): axios.get(`${siteConfig.url}/api/cron`); siteConfig.url is the literal public host https://devcircle.live (src/config/site.ts). No in-repo evidence deploys this app at that host (sst.config.ts names www.devcircle.live and its deploy step is commented out in deploy.yml; vercel.json only schedules a cron), so external host per ADR-0209; the path would be api/cron/route.ts GET
deleteForum (server): axios.get(`${siteConfig.url}/api/cron`) on the literal public host https://devcircle.live; external host per ADR-0209, as at line 61
getLinkMetada (server): axios.get(href) where href is the request's ?url= query value, known only at runtime
useMutation mutationFn: axios.patch( with `/api/forum/post/comment` on the next line; comment/route.ts exports const PATCH in `export { GET, PATCH, POST, DELETE }`
editComment: axios.post(`/api/forum/post/comment `, payload); the trailing space is stripped by URL parsing; comment/route.ts's POST edits a comment
reply: axios.patch(`/api/forum/post/comment `, payload); trailing space stripped by URL parsing
createForum: axios.post<string>("/api/forum", payload); forum/route.ts exports createForum as POST
updateForum: axios.patch("/api/forum", payload); editForum as PATCH
mutationFn: axios.patch("/api/user", payload); user/route.ts exports updateUser as PATCH
deleteForum: axios.delete(`/api/forum/?forumId=${forumId}`); Next's default trailingSlash: false redirects /api/forum/ to /api/forum (308 keeps the method), query dropped; deleteForum as DELETE
patchSubscription: axios.patch(`/api/forum/${id}/subscription`); [forumId]/subscription/route.ts exports async function PATCH (no literal sibling has a subscription route)
fetchResults: axios.get( with "/api/posts/search", { params: { query } } on the next lines; posts/search/route.ts exports getUsers as GET
vote: axios.patch("/api/forum/post/comment/vote", payload); exports async function PATCH (next-auth middleware only guards it)
mutationFn: axios.post("/api/forum/post", { ...payload, forumId }); forum/post/route.ts exports createPost as POST
deletePost: axios.delete(`/api/forum/post/?postId=${postId}`); trailing slash redirected away (trailingSlash: false), query dropped; deletePost as DELETE
fetchPosts (passed to useInfiniteQuery with key "infinite-query", which it ignores): axios.get(query), query = `/api/posts?${queryParams}` on line 67; retrievePosts as GET
vote: axios.patch("/api/forum/post/vote", payload); vote/route.ts exports patchVotes as PATCH
mutationFn: axios.patch("/api/forum/post", { ...payload, postId }); editPost as PATCH
